full_judgment:
2. The appeal is preferred against the impugned Judgment and order dated 24-5-2003 passed by the learned Second Court. Additional Sessions Judge, Satkhira convicting the appellant and others under sections 302/34 of the Penal Code and sentencing each of them to suffer imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Taka 50,000 in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 3(three) years more. Appellant Nos. 2-4 under section 326 of the Penal Code and sentencing each of them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 10(ten) years and pay a fine of Taka 10,000 for each in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 1(one) year more, both the sentences to run concurrently and convicting the appellant No. 5 under section 323 of the Penal Code and sentencing him to suffer rigorous imprisonment for 1(one) year in Sessions Case No. 27 of 1997 arising out of Ashashuni Police Station Case No. 4 dated 6-3-1995 under sections 143/ 323/324/325/307. 

 3. Mr Md Khurshid Alam Khan with Mr Mohammad Hossain, the learned Advocates appearing for the appellant-petitioners, submits that admittedly occurrence took place out of previous enmity between the appellant and the deceased party and initially the case was recorded under sections 143/323/ 324/325/307 of the Penal Code. He further submitted final report against appellant petitioner No. 1 but on naraji petition subsequently was submitted charge-sheet was submitted. Mr Khan relies upon decision reported in 2 BLC 401 wherein it laid down that the appellant convicted on charge of murder is entitled to bail if it is based on no other allegation than giving an order to commit the offence.
